# Example: QS + site supervisor (illustrative)

**Goal:** Distinguish commercial/scope documents from site observations and make clarification owners explicit. This example is NOT a work order, method statement, site instruction, or safety approval.

All references are invented identifiers, all domain rules are unapproved. This repository has no access to actual drawings, a BOQ or a site.

Run `python scripts/validate_spec.py examples/construction-scope` from repository root after installing `PyYAML`.
